Package sysmlinjava.attributetypes

package sysmlinjava.attributetypes
SysMLinJava representation of SysML attribute types.

Numerous commonly used attribute types are provided. As in SysML, base attribute types for real, integer, string, and boolean are provided as are many specializations of these value types.

Each value type is an ObservableValue which is observable by AttributeObservers. The observable value enables emulation of the "binding" connector for the attributes used for parameter bindings and other models requiring attribute change notification.

Attribute types in SysMLinJava models are not limited to the types in this package. Additional attribute types may be created by simply extending the SysMLAttributeType, or any of the specializations of the SysMLAttributeType contained in this package.
